summary: Adapt the existing Opal Owner Control gateway to an isolated Nginx instance on TCP 8443 with one nobody request worker, leaving the vendor Nginx service untouched.

sources.title: Nginx core module: user directive
sources.relevance: Documents master/worker privilege separation and the user/group applied to worker processes.

sources.title: OpenWrt procd init scripts
sources.relevance: Documents use of procd-managed services and respawn behavior already available on the Opal.

sources.title: GL-SFT1200 read-only inventory
sources.locator: Actual Opal read-only SSH inventory on 2026-10-15; recorded in current task output and staged gateway README
sources.relevance: Confirms Nginx 1.17.7 with SSL/Lua, OpenWrt 18.06 procd, nobody/nogroup, root-only existing key permissions, free 8443, current services, and memory readings.

findings.statement: Nginx has a native user directive for worker process identity; its privileged master can maintain the control plane while request workers run with reduced privileges.
OpenWrt procd supports a separately managed and respawned service; this is installed on the target router.
The Opal's existing Nginx global workers run as root, and the existing service is working; a root-only TLS key and separate free port are present constraints.

native_capability_check.capability: Existing Nginx worker privilege drop, dedicated config, listener, and procd service supervision
native_capability_check.rationale: Reuse the installed Nginx binary and procd, with a dedicated configuration and TCP 8443 listener; leave global Nginx config and workers unchanged.

alternatives.name: Change the existing global Nginx worker user
alternatives.compatibility: Would alter every existing GL.iNet site including administration and Skins relay
alternatives.rationale: Expands blast radius to working router services.

alternatives.name: Run the entire gateway Nginx instance as nobody
alternatives.compatibility: Cannot read the existing root:root mode-0600 TLS private key without weakening key permissions or adding privilege helper
alternatives.documentation_support: Platform file permissions and existing key metadata
alternatives.rationale: Would require weakening private-key access or additional privilege infrastructure.

alternatives.name: Dedicated Nginx instance with root master and nobody worker
alternatives.maturity: Native Nginx feature plus existing procd service manager
alternatives.maintenance: One additional small service/configuration to monitor
alternatives.compatibility: Reuses installed Nginx TLS/Lua and root-only key; isolated port/config/PID/state paths
alternatives.rationale: Smallest supported path that preserves the existing service and keeps request handling unprivileged.

decision_rationale.selected_path: Add one separate Nginx/procd instance on 8443 and run its single request worker as nobody:nogroup.
decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: A root master remains privileged to open the existing 0600 TLS key, but it handles no client requests; the request worker is dropped to nobody. This is narrower than changing global Nginx and avoids key permission changes.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: Adds one procd service and an estimated memory overhead based on current RSS; actual runtime overhead and boot recovery remain unmeasured until guarded installation.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Reuse installed Nginx, Lua/TLS modules, and procd; isolate config, PID, logs, state, temp files, and listener.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: The UI requires trusted HTTPS/WSS on the Opal while preserving current services and avoiding root request processing.
alternatives_considered: Run complete Nginx service as nobody
Dedicated Nginx instance using native worker user drop

rollback_or_exit_path.rollback_path: Package rollback.sh disables/stops only the dedicated service and restores exact v1.0.1 local-transport.js hash.
rollback_or_exit_path.uninstall_or_removal_path: Remove only isolated config/service/Lua/session/log paths after service is stopped; installer preserves these paths if stop/disable cannot be verified.
rollback_or_exit_path.replacement_path: Restore the previous Opal Mission Control transport and remove dedicated port listener.
rollback_or_exit_path.recovery_method: Run the package's exact rollback script from its preserved root backup.
rollback_or_exit_path.prior_known_good_state: Existing global Nginx, Skins relay, and Mission Control transport v1.0.1 remain untouched until guarded installation.
